notes: Budgets for tools/scripts/plugin_footprint_check.py. Sizes are bytes of the arm64 slice; mapped_bytes excludes __LINKEDIT, so strip settings do not move it. Measured on the pulp-gain examples (Release, Skia m153): PulpGain 26.59 MB mapped with 4.85 MB ICU data (32.6 MB mapped and 10.88 MB ICU data with the full package); PulpGain built LITE_EDITOR 2.05 MB with no Skia, Dawn, Tint, ICU or GPU host; PulpGainHeadless (NO_EDITOR) 0.56 MB; the canvas-text test binary 4.85 MB ICU data. Each budget fails if the ICU subset or the editor-less link boundary is lost.
